examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The three steps: 28px, 32px and 40px tall. Pick the one the row it sits in already uses — a group 6px off its neighbour reads as a rendering mistake.

examples.name: Fluid
examples.summary: By default the group hugs its labels (top). `fluid` gives it the container width and lets the options divide that row between them (bottom) — which is what a two-answer question at the head of a form card wants, instead of two pills bunched at the left with dead space beside them.
